search_window.basis: Previous verified heartbeat completion through current observation. Search results were checked for actual publication/event timing; older stories and duplicate signals were excluded.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall of high-value Food Line missed classes, not primary nationwide collection.
classes_checked: Only/sole/last/full-service local grocery lost or closed due to fire, disaster or shutdown
Emergency food distribution canceled or suspended by storm, flood, fire, power outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food bank shutdown or major service access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences

coverage_notes.observation: All twelve web searches returned results, but none provided a verified new qualifying U.S. food-access interruption during the hourly window. Search responses disproportionately surfaced stale 2025 SNAP shutdown stories, earlier 2026 closures and routine pantry/news coverage.

coverage_notes.limitations: Targeted web-search coverage cannot establish absence of incidents in all communities; provider notices and local news may be delayed or unindexed.
coverage_notes.production_authority: Primary nationwide collection remains authoritative. No editorial review/approval, publishing, schedule changes or task disabling.
